## Problem

Describe the concrete problem this change solves.

## Behavior

Describe the externally observable behavior before and after this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover success and failure paths.
- [ ] Public API changes are documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when appropriate.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, private prompts, or proprietary Brivvvy implementation details are included.
- [ ] The change preserves deterministic evaluation and fail-safe behavior.
